nav.inventoryHubDescription: Choose a section to manage products, stock, and catalog data.
nav.adminHubDescription: Open dashboard, documentation, or reports from here.

notes.mentionHint: Type @ to link an order, purchase order, payment, or person.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyLowStock: No low stock items. All products are well stocked.

control.title: Control
control.intro: Turn features on or off for this browser. Each item describes what it affects in the app.
control.securityNote: These toggles only hide or show UI. They do not block API access. Use database policies for real enforcement.

disabled.newOrder: Creating new orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.editDraft: Editing draft orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.ordersList: The order list is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.noOrderShortcuts: All order hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.inventoryHubAllOff: All inventory hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.adminHubAllOff: All Admin shortcuts are turned off in Control settings. Enable Dashboard, Documentation, or Reports under Navigation.
disabled.purchaseOrdersList: The purchase order list is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.noPurchaseOrderShortcuts: All purchase order hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.newPurchaseOrder: Creating new purchase orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.dashboardAllOff: Both dashboard tabs are turned off in Control. Turn on “Overview” or “Reports” to see content here.
disabled.dashboardOverviewEmpty: All overview sections are turned off in Control. Enable stats, financial snapshot, movements, or low stock to see widgets here.

dashboard.title: Dashboard menu
dashboard.desc: Shows the Dashboard item under the Admin group in the sidebar (home / overview).

control.title: Control menu
control.desc: Shows the Control link to open this feature settings page.

inventory.title: Inventory menu
inventory.desc: Shows the Inventory item in the sidebar (hub and sub-routes).

orders.title: Orders menu
orders.desc: Shows the Orders item in the sidebar.

people.title: People menu
people.desc: Shows the People item in the sidebar.

payments.title: Payments menu
payments.desc: Shows the Payments item in the sidebar (hub, history, and new payment).

register.title: Register menu
register.desc: Shows the Register item for cash-drawer balances by tender and manual add/withdraw.

admin.title: Admin menu
admin.desc: Shows the Admin link in the sidebar; opens the Admin hub with shortcuts to Dashboard, Documentation, and Reports.

documentation.title: Documentation page
documentation.desc: Shows the Documentation link under Admin and enables the /documentation user guide route.

reports.title: Reports shortcut (sidebar)
reports.desc: Shows the Reports link under Admin (opens the dashboard Reports tab).

lowStockBell.title: Low stock alerts (bell)
lowStockBell.desc: Shows the bell icon and badge linking to low-stock products.

overviewTab.title: Overview tab
overviewTab.desc: Shows the main dashboard tab (stats and activity widgets).

reportsTab.title: Reports tab
reportsTab.desc: Shows the Reports tab on the home page and allows opening sales/inventory reports there.

statsCards.title: Top stat cards
statsCards.desc: Product count, inventory value, low-stock count, movements today, and purchases today.

financialSnapshot.title: Receivables & payables
financialSnapshot.desc: The two cards for total receivables and total payables.

recentMovements.title: Recent stock movements
recentMovements.desc: The table of latest stock in/out/adjustments on the overview.

lowStockPanel.title: Low stock list
lowStockPanel.desc: The low-stock products panel on the overview.

deposit.title: Add to register
deposit.desc: Allows recording money put into the register (by tender type).

withdraw.title: Withdraw from register
withdraw.desc: Allows recording money taken out of the register (by tender type).

viewActivity.title: Register activity
viewActivity.desc: Shows the recent activity table and the “View activity” shortcut on the Register page.

list.title: Transaction log
list.desc: Opens the full balance ledger: orders, purchase orders, payments, wallet, and adjustments.

editLedgerNote.title: Edit payment notes
editLedgerNote.desc: Allow changing the note on recorded payment-in / payment-out operations from the payment detail page.

reverseLedgerOperation.title: Reverse recorded payments
reverseLedgerOperation.desc: Allow undoing a payment-in / payment-out, or a register deposit/withdraw, from the payment detail page (ledger, balance, and linked order/PO rows when applicable).

fullLedgerView.title: Full ledger mode (transaction log)
fullLedgerView.desc: Shows the “Show full ledger” option on the payments list to expand reversed rows and see raw balance impact.

products.title: Products card
products.desc: Link from the inventory hub to the products list.

po.title: Purchase orders card
po.desc: Link from the inventory hub to purchase orders.

movements.title: Stock movements card
movements.desc: Link from the inventory hub to stock movements.

categories.title: Categories card
categories.desc: Link from the inventory hub to categories.

brands.title: Brands card
brands.desc: Link from the inventory hub to brands.

viewProfile.title: View profile
viewProfile.desc: Shows the eye icon and allows opening the person profile dialog with balance and history.

editPerson.title: Edit person
editPerson.desc: Allows editing customer or supplier details from the list and from the profile dialog.

deletePerson.title: Delete person
deletePerson.desc: Shows the delete action when allowed by business rules.

recordPayment.title: Record payment
recordPayment.desc: Allows recording balance payments from Payments → New payment (choose person).

addPerson.title: Add person
addPerson.desc: Shows the button to create a new customer or supplier.

add.title: Add product
add.desc: Shows the Add product button on the products page.

edit.title: Edit product
edit.desc: Shows the edit (pencil) action for each product row.

delete.title: Delete product
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for each product row.

stockAdjust.title: Stock adjustment
stockAdjust.desc: Shows the stock adjust action to change quantity manually.

edit.title: Edit category
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a category name.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a category.

edit.title: Edit brand
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a brand name.

delete.title: Delete brand
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a brand.

hubList.title: All purchase orders card
hubList.desc: Shows the shortcut to the purchase orders list on the purchase orders home page.

create.title: Create purchase order
create.desc: Shows the new purchase order shortcut and enables the full-page create flow (supplier picker, product browser, lines, payments).

confirmReceive.title: Confirm / receive draft PO
confirmReceive.desc: Shows the button on a draft purchase order to confirm receipt, enter supplier payments, and post stock.

cancel.title: Cancel purchase order
cancel.desc: Shows the cancel action on received purchase orders (detail page).

editNote.title: Edit purchase order note
editNote.desc: Allows editing the persisted note on a purchase order detail page (pen icon, save).

hubList.title: All orders card
hubList.desc: Shows the shortcut to the orders list on the orders home page.

hubNew.title: New order card
hubNew.desc: Shows the shortcut to create a new order and enables the new-order page.

editDraft.title: Edit draft orders
editDraft.desc: Allows opening the POS editor for draft orders from the order detail page.

saveDraft.title: Save draft
saveDraft.desc: Shows the Save draft button in the POS header.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.desc: Shows the Checkout button and checkout flow (payments and confirm).

print.title: Print invoice
print.desc: Shows print invoice on the order detail page.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.desc: Shows cancel order on the order detail page when status allows.

addPayment.title: Add payment (reserved)
addPayment.desc: Reserved for future use: partial payments on confirmed orders from the order screen. Checkout payments are controlled by Checkout and Record payment.

editNote.title: Edit order note
editNote.desc: Allows editing the order note field on the detail page.

export.title: Export CSV
export.desc: Shows export to CSV on dashboard reports (e.g. inventory value).
